subject: Fleet relay (Phase 2): reach the fleet page from outside the LAN
description:
PARKED: needs an explicit go-ahead.

Goal: reach the fleet page away from the LAN, via a small relay. Shaped in
design/fleet-pairing.md section 6; a Cloudflare Worker is the evidenced candidate.

Phase 1 shipped in v1.78-v1.79: token pairing plus the same-user loopback gate. Phase 2 is the
relay itself.

Hard constraint from the design: corp assets must never make a single new outbound connection.
Whatever the relay is, that property is the thing to preserve, and it is why this is not a
"just tunnel it" task.
